description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Method for determination of Custom Value for disposal of vehicles imported or registered on or before 19.11.2015 on 100% duty/tax free basis by the Diplomats and Diplomatic Organizations
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes a method for determining customs value for disposal of vehicles imported duty-free by diplomats, under the authority of the Customs (Amendment) Act. It contains specific regulatory provisions, formulas, and percentages for calculating values, and rescinds a previous notification. This content primarily deals with legal/regulatory framework and compliance requirements for customs procedures, fitting Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) for legal framework and regulatory matters.
